definitions.gloss: approval; adoption; passage (of a bill, motion)
definitions.explanation: Official approval or adoption of a proposal, bill, or motion by a voting body such as a parliament or committee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賛成多数|さんせいたすう}→賛成多数：09759_sanseitasuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{可決|かけつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill was passed with a majority vote.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算案|よさんあん}→予算案：09761_yosanan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{可決|かけつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The budget proposal is expected to be approved next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動議|どうぎ}→動議：09762_dougi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{可決|かけつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: Used in political and formal organizational contexts when a proposal or bill is officially approved.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{可決|かけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {可決|かけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pass, to approve)
- {可決|かけつ}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be passed/approved)
- ⟦{賛成多数|さんせいたすう}→賛成多数：09759_sanseitasuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{可決|かけつ} (passed with majority support)
- ⟦{全会一致|ぜんかいいっち}→全会一致：09760_zenkaiicchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{可決|かけつ} (passed unanimously)

TYPES OF PASSAGE:
- ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧{可決|かけつ} (passed by House of Representatives)
- ⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧{可決|かけつ} (passed by House of Councillors)
- ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧{可決|かけつ} (passed by committee)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧ (rejection, voting down)

ASPECT (ている):
- {可決|かけつ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: has been passed / has been approved (passive resultative — the most common form in news contexts)
- Note: {可決|かけつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is a punctual achievement verb — the moment of passage is instantaneous. The て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form describes the lasting state of having been passed, not an ongoing vote. In news reports, the passive {可決|かけつ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧ (past) and {可決|かけつ}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧ (resultative) are far more common than the active forms.
